{{Top|leg}}
'''Tranthebar mountain ripper racing''' was a racing sport. Competitors rode [[Tranthebar mountain ripper]]s using [[TRHA-300 Control Harness]]es. The sport was confined to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tranthellix]], the homeworld of the [[Bird/Legends|avian]] Tranthebar mountain ripper.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
